title: Koca Mustafa Pasha Mosque
geometryBasis: The named current outline measures 25.89 m along the east-west body and 21.93 m across. The historic measured plan locates the dome, converted north entrance, partly visible early eastern apse and western minaret relative to its outer walls.
sectionBasis: Van Millingen’s 1912 field survey records the lead roofs, plain molded cornices, pale dressed stone elsewhere and alternating brick and stone in the drum. The Istanbul Governorship and Eyice document five surviving portico bays, the eight-sided drum, two semidomes and minaret details.
limitations: The measured historic plan locates the surviving converted church. The current heritage register supplies the five courtyard bays following restoration. Fine window spacing, dome and minaret elevations, and the external masonry colors are estimated.

The original local elevation is a regional raster and constrains the approach and grade. The recorded historic finishes are simplified in the shared viewer. Interiors and separately mapped tombs, fountains and schools are outside the mosque exterior scope.
